name: Server Keeper
summary: Live stats, alerts and one-click maintenance for this server.
description: Server Keeper shows how your Automaton server and its Runners are doing: CPU, memory, disk and load with 24 hours of history, Docker disk use, OS name and uptime, pending and security updates, restart required, server and Runner versions and whether a newer release exists, certificate expiry and the last backup. Sends one warning, by email through the server's SMTP and by webhook, when disk space runs low, security updates wait too long, a restart is overdue, the server backup is older than 26 hours or failed, or the Off-site Backup app failed or has not run for 26 hours (this replaces Watchtower), and one message when it is resolved. Studio Home shows a card with the status, disk, last backup, version and the active alerts, and the alerts reach Studio's notification feed. It asks for server:read, notify:email, backups:read and apps:read-status. A Maintenance section lists every task with its last result and next run: the nightly cleanup (with its time, keep days and journal limit), backup, Runner upgrades and OS updates. With server:cleanup, backups:run and runner:maintain approved (and server:update-os for the OS updates), a system administrator can run the cleanup or a backup now, change the cleanup settings and upgrade old Runners; other people only read. With runner:maintain approved for a Runner by an administrator, a system administrator can run the Docker cleanup now, read an app's recent logs, restart an app, read Docker's disk use, install security updates and restart that one machine (each after typing its name); nothing else is changed on the server.

application.description: Live stats, alerts and one-click maintenance for this server.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py console.py homecard.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py console.py homecard.py index.html dashboard.js console.css dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Optional. Base URL of this Automaton server's API; normally the server provides it, so leave empty

settings.name: STUDIO_URL
settings.description: Optional. Address of Studio for the Change in Studio link on the Cleanup card; normally worked out from the page or the API address, so leave empty

settings.name: EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets warning emails through the server's SMTP: administrators, owner, project or off

settings.name: DISK_FREE_WARN_PERCENT
settings.description: Warn when less than this percent of the disk is free

settings.name: SECURITY_UPDATE_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when security updates have been waiting longer than this many days

settings.name: REBOOT_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when a restart has been required longer than this many days

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Where warnings are sent: a Slack, Discord or Telegram webhook URL, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. Optional, in addition to the email. Empty: no webhook
